items.title: Terri Lyne Carrington interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003
items.q: that Shakyamuni Buddha, the original Buddha, he wrote many teachings

ctx.x: G-O-H-O-N-Z-O-N. And it’s called — well now it’s changed its name to Soka Gakkai International. And it’s basically a Buddhist philosophy that’s based on a man named Nichiren Daishonin and he was around about 700 years ago, and it’s based on Sutra, that Shakyamuni Buddha, the original Buddha, he wrote many teachings and many writings over the years but — my stomach, you hear that? — but the Sutra that he wrote that this Buddhism is based on is the Lotus Sutra. And the Lotus Flower that grows out of mud and it’s…
